snippet.title: Drawing Impostor: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A drawing game where one of your friends doesn't know what to draw. For 3 to 12 friends, coming to Steam.

Wishlist it, or join the Playtest: search Drawing Impostor on Steam

Music: "The Builder" by Kevin MacLeod, edited, CC BY 4.0
